verdict.rationale: Open-sourcing the product's code is a fair question for a SaaS speech-to-text API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no source release and no open license for the transcription service. The only GitHub item is a separate ClawHub skill wrapper, which is not the product's own source, and the pack states no license for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
